SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') THEN 'DC Comics' WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') THEN 'Marvel Comics' ELSE 'Tie' END AS "publisher", ABS(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')) AS "count_difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics') LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".height_cm) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 AND "s".id IN (SELECT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" WHERE "hp".power_id NOT IN (SELECT "dhp".power_id FROM "superhero" AS "dc" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dp" ON "dc".publisher_id = "dp".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "dhp" ON "dhp".hero_id = "dc".id WHERE "dp".publisher_name = 'DC Comics')) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM (SELECT "hp".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id GROUP BY "hp".power_id HAVING BOOL_OR("sp".power_name = 'Super Strength') AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "hero_power" AS "other_hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "other_sp" ON "other_sp".id = "other_hp".power_id WHERE "other_hp".hero_id = "hp".hero_id AND "other_sp".power_name = 'Super Strength')) = 0) AS "qualifying_powers" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "a".alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad') LIMIT 501

WITH "counts" AS (SELECT "sp".power_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND "s".full_name <> '-' GROUP BY "sp".power_name), "maximum" AS (SELECT MAX(hero_count) AS "hero_count" FROM "counts") SELECT "counts".power_name, "counts".hero_count FROM "counts" INNER JOIN "maximum" ON "counts".hero_count = "maximum".hero_count ORDER BY "counts".power_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_measured_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT "ha2".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "ab" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" ON "ha2".hero_id = "ab".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "ab".superhero_name = 'Abomination' AND "a2".attribute_name = 'Intelligence') AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "g".gender, COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) AS "superhero_count" FROM "gender" AS "g" LEFT JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".hair_colour_id AND "c".colour = 'Blue' LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') GROUP BY "g".gender HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".id IS NOT NULL) >= 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg))::BIGINT AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "h" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha_h" ON "ha_h".hero_id = "h".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha_h".attribute_id INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha_all" ON "ha_all".attribute_id = "a".id AND "ha_all".attribute_value = "ha_h".attribute_value INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".id = "ha_all".hero_id WHERE "h".superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked" AS (SELECT id, height_cm, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC) AS "height_rank" FROM "superhero" WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL AND height_cm <> 0), "tallest" AS (SELECT id FROM "ranked" WHERE height_rank <= 10) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "different_superpowers" FROM "tallest" AS "t" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "t".id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "target" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "target_publisher" ON "target".publisher_id = "target_publisher".id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "character" ON "character".publisher_id = "target_publisher".id INNER JOIN "race" ON "character".race_id = "race".id WHERE "target".superhero_name = 'A-Bomb' AND "race".race = '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 2) AS "average_superpowers_per_hero" FROM (SELECT "s".id, COUNT("hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "s".race_id = "r".id INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "r".race = 'God / Eternal' AND "g".gender = 'Male' GROUP BY "s".id) AS "hero_counts" LIMIT 501

WITH "cryo_holders" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "sp".power_name = 'Cryokinesis'), "related_heroes" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "cp" ON "cp".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "cryo_holders" AS "ch" ON "ch".hero_id = "cp".hero_id), "power_counts" AS (SELECT "rh".hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "related_heroes" AS "rh" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "rh".hero_id GROUP BY "rh".hero_id) SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_number_of_superpowers" FROM "power_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("dc".weight_kg)) FROM "superhero" AS "dc" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dc_pub" ON "dc".publisher_id = "dc_pub".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "dc_eye" ON "dc".eye_colour_id = "dc_eye".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "marvel_eye".colour FROM "superhero" AS "marvel" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "marvel_pub" ON "marvel".publisher_id = "marvel_pub".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "marvel_eye" ON "marvel".eye_colour_id = "marvel_eye".id WHERE "marvel_pub".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "shared_eye" ON "shared_eye".colour = "dc_eye".colour WHERE "dc_pub".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "dc".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "a" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".race_id = "a".race_id WHERE "a".superhero_name = 'A-Bomb' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".weight_kg) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 AND "r".race <> '-' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "superhero" AS "female_hero" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "female_hero".gender_id WHERE "female_hero".race_id = "s".race_id AND "g".gender = 'Female') LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "s".publisher_id) AS "publisher_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "s".height_cm > 200 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good' AND ("p".publisher_name <> 'DC Comics' OR "p".id IS NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg", COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "h".id) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "b" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "h" ON "h".publisher_id = "b".publisher_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "other_h" ON "other_h".eye_colour_id = "h".eye_colour_id WHERE "b".superhero_name = 'Blackwulf' AND "h".eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL AND "other_h".publisher_id IS NOT NULL AND "other_h".publisher_id <> "h".publisher_id LIMIT 501

WITH "target_publisher" AS (SELECT publisher_id FROM "superhero" WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'), "race_counts" AS (SELECT "r".race, COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "target_publisher" AS "tp" ON "s".publisher_id = "tp".publisher_id INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "s".race_id = "r".id WHERE "r".race <> '-' GROUP BY "r".race) SELECT race, superhero_count FROM "race_counts" WHERE superhero_count = (SELECT MAX(superhero_count) FROM "race_counts") ORDER BY race ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("ha".attribute_value)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_intelligence_score" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "sp".power_name IN ('Super Speed', 'Death Touch') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm) FILTER (WHERE "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg) FILTER (WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "c".colour = 'Green' LIMIT 501

SELECT (SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm)::NUMERIC, 1) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0) AS "average_height_cm", (SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 1) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0) AS "average_weight_kg" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(height_cm)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "other_hero".id, "other_hero".height_cm FROM "superhero" AS "target" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_power" ON "target_power".hero_id = "target".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "shared_power" ON "shared_power".power_id = "target_power".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "other_hero" ON "other_hero".id = "shared_power".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man' AND "other_hero".id <> "target".id AND "other_hero".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "other_hero".height_cm <> 0) AS "shared_power_heroes" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "p" ON "p".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "p".power_name = 'Flight' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "s".id, "s".weight_kg FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0) AS "heroes" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "different_superpower_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Male' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 AND "s".weight_kg < 70 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "s".race_id = "r".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".hair_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "r".race = 'Human' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 AND "s".height_cm = (SELECT MIN("s2".height_cm) FROM "superhero" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r2" ON "s2".race_id = "r2".id WHERE "r2".race = 'Human' AND "s2".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s2".height_cm <> 0) LIMIT 501

WITH "lightest" AS (SELECT MIN(weight_kg) AS "weight_kg" FROM "superhero" WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND weight_kg <> 0), "per_hero" AS (SELECT "s".id, COUNT(DISTINCT "sp".power_name) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" CROSS JOIN "lightest" AS "l" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id LEFT JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "s".weight_kg = "l".weight_kg GROUP BY "s".id) SELECT MAX(power_count) AS "max_superpower_count" FROM "per_hero" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s"."alignment_id" = "a"."id" WHERE "a"."alignment" = 'Neutral' AND "s"."full_name" IS NOT NULL AND "s"."full_name" <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Speed' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Speed') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND "s".full_name <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "eye_colours".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) AS "hero_count" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "eye".colour AS "colour" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "eye" ON "eye".id = "s".eye_colour_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "hair" ON "hair".id = "s".hair_colour_id WHERE "hair".colour = 'Brown') AS "eye_colours" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "eye" ON "eye".colour = "eye_colours".colour INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "eye".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "hair" ON "hair".id = "s".hair_colour_id WHERE "hair".colour <> 'Brown' GROUP BY "eye_colours".colour ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye_colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND "s".full_name <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".alignment = 'Good' THEN "s".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "s".id, "s".weight_kg FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp3" ON "hp3".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s3" ON "s3".id = "hp3".hero_id WHERE "s".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 AND "s3".superhero_name = '3-D Man') AS "distinct_heroes" LIMIT 501

SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'No Colour') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour ILIKE 'blue')) AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NULL OR "s".weight_kg = 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN "l".id END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "l".id END), 0) AS "male_to_female_ratio" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".ua IS NOT NULL AND (("p".sex = 'M' AND "l".ua > 8.0) OR ("p".sex = 'F' AND "l".ua > 6.5)) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".alb)::NUMERIC, 4) AS "average_alb" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".plt > 400 AND "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l".alb IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".tg >= 200 AND "p".birthday < DATE '1976-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".glu >= 180 AND "l"."T-CHO" < 250 AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".hct >= 52 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".birthday HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 2) AS "female_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday < DATE '1971-10-09' AND "l".date <= DATE '2026-10-09' AND "l".pt >= 14 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".crp LIKE '%+%' AND "p".description IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') AND "e".symptoms IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '+(')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory") AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1930-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1941-01-01' AND "p".admission IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("p".admission) <> '' LIMIT 501

WITH "strongest" AS (SELECT MAX("rnp"::NUMERIC) AS "max_rnp" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "rnp" IS NOT NULL AND "rnp" <> 'negative'), "eligible" AS (SELECT "l"."id", "l"."date", "l"."T-BIL", "l"."rnp" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" CROSS JOIN "strongest" AS "s" WHERE "l"."rnp" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."rnp" <> 'negative' AND "l"."rnp"::NUMERIC = "s".max_rnp AND "l"."T-BIL" IS NOT NULL) SELECT "e"."T-BIL", "e"."date", "p"."id", "p"."sex", "p"."birthday" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p"."id" = "e"."id" WHERE "e"."T-BIL" = (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") FROM "eligible") LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p"."id") AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e"."id" = "p"."id" AND "e"."thrombosis" = 1 WHERE "p"."birthday" > DATE '1960-01-01' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "l".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')), "titers" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp::INTEGER AS "rnp_titer" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "eligible" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$') SELECT id, MAX(rnp_titer) AS "rnp_titer" FROM "titers" GROUP BY id HAVING MAX(rnp_titer) = (SELECT MAX(rnp_titer) FROM "titers") ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p"."id") AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "platelet" ON "platelet"."id" = "p"."id" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "antibody" ON "antibody"."id" = "p"."id" WHERE "p"."diagnosis" = 'MCTD' AND "platelet"."plt" BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "antibody"."rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "antibody"."rnp"::INTEGER > 5 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("lab".date_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_laboratory_test_dates" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT id FROM "examination" WHERE id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY id) AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS "date_count" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "lab" ON "lab".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "e".id IS NULL GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".dna::NUMERIC AS "dna_level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL), "ranked" AS (SELECT id, date, dna_level, MAX(dna_level) OVER (PARTITION BY id) AS "highest_level" FROM "eligible") SELECT id, date, dna_level FROM "ranked" WHERE dna_level = highest_level ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_patients" AS (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::INTEGER > 16), "settings" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".admission FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "qualifying_patients" AS "q" ON "q".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-')) SELECT admission, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "settings" GROUP BY admission ORDER BY admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".id IN (SELECT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".plt > 100 AND "l".plt < 400)) AS "patients_with_normal_platelet_result", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".id NOT IN (SELECT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".plt > 100 AND "l".plt < 400)) AS "patients_never_with_normal_platelet_result" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".diagnosis ~ '(^|[,[:space:]])RA([,[:space:]]|$)' AND "p".diagnosis ~ '(^|[,[:space:]])SJS([,[:space:]]|$)' AND "p".diagnosis !~ 'susp' AND "p".diagnosis !~ '[^[:alnum:],[:space:]]' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".tp - 8.5)::NUMERIC, 3) AS "average_deviation" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".tp > 8.5 AND "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE birthday >= DATE '1960-01-01') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".alb < 3.5 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l"."rnp" <> 'negative' AND "l"."rnp"::INTEGER > 64) / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l"."rnp" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) AS "women", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN "p".id END) AS "men" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 32 LIMIT 501

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date)::INT - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)::INT) AS "youngest_age_years" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INT >= 64 LIMIT 501

WITH "psoriatic_patients" AS (SELECT "id" FROM "patient" WHERE "diagnosis" ILIKE 'Psoriatic arthritis'), "test_counts" AS (SELECT "p"."id", COUNT("l"."id") AS "test_count" FROM "psoriatic_patients" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l"."id" = "p"."id" GROUP BY "p"."id") SELECT SUM(test_count) AS "total_laboratory_tests", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE test_count = 0) AS "patients_with_no_laboratory_tests" FROM "test_counts" LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1998-01-01' AND thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT split_part("e".symptoms, ',', 1) AS "symptom" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "e".thrombosis = 1 AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY split_part("e".symptoms, ',', 1) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, split_part("e".symptoms, ',', 1) ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "diagnosis" ILIKE '%SLE%') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "examination" WHERE "thrombosis" = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."Examination Date" - "p"."First Date")) AS "average_delay_days" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission LIKE '%+%' AND "p"."First Date" IS NOT NULL AND "e"."Examination Date" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1995-01-01' AND "l".got < 60 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "completed_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".ldh > 600 AND "l".ldh < 800 AND (CASE WHEN "l"."U-PRO" LIKE '>=%' THEN replace(replace("l"."U-PRO", '>=', ''), ' ', '')::NUMERIC WHEN "l"."U-PRO" ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l"."U-PRO"::NUMERIC ELSE NULL END) >= 300 AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "difference" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'RA' AND "l".un < 30 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_cre_out_of_range", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "total_patients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "grouped_readings" AS (SELECT "p".admission AS "admission_status", "l".id AS "patient_id", "l"."T-CHO" AS "t_cho", MAX("l"."T-CHO") OVER (PARTITION BY "p".admission) AS "group_max" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL) SELECT admission_status, t_cho, patient_id FROM "grouped_readings" WHERE t_cho = group_max ORDER BY CASE admission_status WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END ASC, patient_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "l".rnp FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER = (SELECT MAX("l2".rnp::INTEGER) FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p2"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l2".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l2".rnp <> 'negative') LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("l".hct) AS "average_hematocrit" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l".hct IS NOT NULL AND ("l"."U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('+2(100)', '4')) LIMIT 501

WITH "high_proteinuria" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+1(30)', '+2(100)')), "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".admission FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "high_proteinuria" AS "h" ON "h".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'SLE') SELECT CASE WHEN admission = '+' OR admission = '+(' THEN 'admitted to hospital' ELSE 'outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting", COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "eligible" GROUP BY CASE WHEN admission = '+' OR admission = '+(' THEN 'admitted to hospital' ELSE 'outpatient clinic' END LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rf IN ('-', '+-') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id AND ("e".kct = '+' OR "e".rvvt = '+' OR "e".lac = '+')) LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_sample" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "max_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id), "latest_sc170" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, sc170 FROM "laboratory" WHERE sc170 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC, date DESC) SELECT "ls".id FROM "latest_sample" AS "ls" INNER JOIN "latest_sc170" AS "s" ON "s".id = "ls".id WHERE "ls".max_date > DATE '1997-01-01' AND "s".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') ORDER BY "ls".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM (SELECT "ssa".id FROM "laboratory" AS "ssa" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "urine" ON "urine".id = "ssa".id WHERE "ssa".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "ssa".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0') AND "urine"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "urine"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0') GROUP BY "ssa".id) AS "qualifying_patients" LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".dna::NUMERIC < 8 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission <> '-' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".alp >= 300) LIMIT 501

SELECT MAX("l".rnp::NUMERIC) AS "highest_anti_rnp_level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".cre < 1.5 AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN 'male' END AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".hgb < 7.0 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".rnp::INTEGER AS "rnp" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".got >= 60 AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative'), "top_reading" AS (SELECT MAX(rnp) AS "max_rnp" FROM "eligible") SELECT "p".id, "e".date, "e".rnp FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id CROSS JOIN "top_reading" AS "t" WHERE "e".rnp = "t".max_rnp LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1980-01-01' AND (("l".fg IS NOT NULL AND ("l".fg < 150 OR "l".fg > 450)) OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "patient_group", COUNT(*) AS "normal_ldh_measurements" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l".ldh < 500 GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NOT NULL) AS "patients_with_any_laboratory_result", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l"."T-BIL" >= 2.0) AS "patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IS NULL OR BTRIM("p".sex) = '' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission LIKE '+%' AND "p".birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "e"."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "anemia" ON "anemia".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "anemia".hgb < 10 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex), "levels" AS (SELECT "e".id, "e".sex, "l".rnp::INTEGER AS "level" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative'), "highest" AS (SELECT id, sex, MAX(level) AS "highest_level" FROM "levels" GROUP BY id, sex) SELECT id, sex, highest_level FROM "highest" WHERE highest_level = (SELECT MAX(highest_level) FROM "highest") LIMIT 501

WITH "first_lab" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, got, rnp FROM "laboratory" ORDER BY id ASC, date ASC) SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "first_lab" WHERE got < 60 AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::NUMERIC > 10 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "l".date, "l"."U-PRO" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."U-PRO" <> '-' AND "l".date = (SELECT MAX("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "p".id AND "l2"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l2"."U-PRO" <> '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".cpk < 250 AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) > 4 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id WHERE "e".thrombosis = 0 AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT birthday FROM "patient" WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::INTEGER >= 16 GROUP BY id) AND id IN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id HAVING COUNT(gpt) FILTER (WHERE gpt >= 60) = 0 AND COUNT(gpt) FILTER (WHERE gpt < 60) > 0) ORDER BY (SELECT MAX(gpt) FROM "laboratory" WHERE "laboratory".id = "patient".id AND gpt < 60) DESC, id ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".pt < 14 AND "l".rnp ~ '^(16|64|256)$' LIMIT 501

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date)::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)::INTEGER - CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "l".date), EXTRACT(DAY FROM "l".date)) < (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "p".birthday), EXTRACT(DAY FROM "p".birthday)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "age_years", "p".diagnosis FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".dna ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' ORDER BY "l".dna::NUMERIC DESC, "l".date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l"."T-BIL" >= 1.2 ORDER BY "p".sex ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'Admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'Followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '1976-10-09' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-')), "elevated" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 4) SELECT "e".care_setting, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "v".id IS NOT NULL) AS "patients_with_elevated_anti_rnp", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "v".id IS NULL) AS "patients_with_no_elevated_anti_rnp" FROM "eligible" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "elevated" AS "v" ON "v".id = "e".id GROUP BY "e".care_setting ORDER BY "e".care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".igg IS NOT NULL AND "l".date = (SELECT MAX("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "p".id AND "l2".igg IS NOT NULL) AND "l".igg >= 2000 LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_igg" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, igg FROM "laboratory" WHERE igg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC, date DESC), "settings" AS (SELECT id, CASE WHEN admission IN ('+', '+(') THEN 'admitted to the hospital' WHEN admission = '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "setting" FROM "patient" WHERE admission IN ('+', '+(', '-')) SELECT setting, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "latest_igg".igg > 900 AND "latest_igg".igg < 2000) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "settings" LEFT JOIN "latest_igg" USING (id) GROUP BY setting ORDER BY setting ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "latest" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "l".id ORDER BY "l".date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".date IS NOT NULL) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "female_minus_male" FROM "latest" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rn = 1 AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 32 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("l".id) "l".id, "l".rnp, "l".cpk FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".id ASC, "l".date DESC) AS "most_recent" WHERE "most_recent".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "most_recent".rnp::INTEGER > 64 AND "most_recent".cpk < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".id IN (SELECT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".ldh >= 500) AND "p".id IN (SELECT "u".id FROM "laboratory" AS "u" WHERE "u"."U-PRO" IN ('100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+2(100)')) ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "sex", COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p"."sex" IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e"."id" = "p"."id") GROUP BY "sex" ORDER BY "sex" ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND admission LIKE '+%' LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".birthday, "p".diagnosis AS "overall_diagnosis", "e"."Examination Date", "e".symptoms FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL), "chosen" AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY birthday ASC, id ASC, "Examination Date" DESC) AS "rn" FROM "qualifying") SELECT symptoms, overall_diagnosis FROM "chosen" WHERE rn = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".diagnosis FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '+(') AND "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1998-02-15' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1998-03-01' AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "p".birthday ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1993-11-01' AND diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".gpt >= 60) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission AS "care_setting", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count", ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 1) AS "average_completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rbc < 3.5 AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patients" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY CASE "p".sex WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_aCL_IgM" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SJS%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SJS susp%' AND "e"."aCL IgM" <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SjS%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%suspect%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE ("p".admission IS NULL OR BTRIM("p".admission) = '' OR "p".admission = '-') AND ("l".rnp = 'negative' OR "l".rnp = '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "l".sm IN ('negative', '0') AND "e".thrombosis = 0 AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+1(30)', '+2(100)') LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "abnormal_rbc" ON "abnormal_rbc".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "positive_rnp" ON "positive_rnp".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND ("abnormal_rbc".rbc <= 3.5 OR "abnormal_rbc".rbc >= 6.0) AND "positive_rnp".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "positive_rnp".rnp <> '0' AND "positive_rnp".rnp <> 'negative' LIMIT 501

SELECT TO_CHAR(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 'FM999999990.0') AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::INTEGER >= 64) AS "qualified_rnp" ON "qualified_rnp".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND "p".birthday > DATE '1956-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F' OR "p".sex = 'M'), 0), 1) AS "women_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1936-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1957-01-01' AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cpk >= 250) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1987-01-01' AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday) - CASE WHEN TO_CHAR("l".date, 'MMDD') < TO_CHAR("p".birthday, 'MMDD') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 50 AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT("a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'o') AS "oxygen_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_oxygen_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS "average_single_bonds_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "a".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "single_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "m2".molecule_id = "a2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '-' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'i' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "iodine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 's' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "sulfur_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' AND "a".element IN ('i', 's') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'f')) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id), 0), 2) AS "percentage_no_fluorine" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE ("a1".element = 'p' AND "a2".element = 'n') OR ("a1".element = 'n' AND "a2".element = 'p') LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '#') AND "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT "p".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "p" WHERE "p".element IN ('p', 'br')) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "chlorine_percentage" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'h')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "fraction_hydrogen", "m".label FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT bond_group, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '+') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '-') AS "carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label, CASE WHEN BOOL_AND("b".bond_type = '-') THEN 'every bond is a single bond' ELSE 'all other molecules' END AS "bond_group" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label) AS "molecule_groups" GROUP BY bond_group LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total_pairs" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '=' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' AND "c".atom_id < "c".atom_id2 LIMIT 501

WITH "plus_atoms" AS (SELECT "a".atom_id, "a".molecule_id, "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+'), "bonded_atoms" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "pa".atom_id, "pa".element FROM "plus_atoms" AS "pa" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "pa".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "pa".atom_id), "element_counts" AS (SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS "bonded_count" FROM "bonded_atoms" GROUP BY element), "ranked" AS (SELECT element, bonded_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY bonded_count DESC) AS "rnk" FROM "element_counts"), "total" AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total_atoms" FROM "plus_atoms") SELECT "r".element, ROUND(100.0 * "r".bonded_count / "t".total_atoms, 2) AS "percentage" FROM "ranked" AS "r" CROSS JOIN "total" AS "t" WHERE "r".rnk = 1 ORDER BY "r".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "a".atom_id = 'TR041_10' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=', '#') GROUP BY "b".bond_type ORDER BY CASE "b".bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 1 WHEN '=' THEN 2 WHEN '#' THEN 3 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "other".atom_id) AS "count" FROM "atom" AS "chlorine" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "chlorine".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "chlorine".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "other" ON "other".atom_id = CASE WHEN "c".atom_id = "chlorine".atom_id THEN "c".atom_id2 ELSE "c".atom_id END WHERE "chlorine".element = 'cl' AND "other".atom_id <> "chlorine".atom_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) FROM "atom" AS "s" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "s".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "s".atom_id WHERE "s".element = 's' AND "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id AND "a".element <> 'na' LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "other_a" ON "other_a".element = "a".element AND "other_a".molecule_id <> "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "other_a".atom_id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "molecule_count" FROM (SELECT "n".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "n" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "n2".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "n2" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "n2".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "n2".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "n2".element = 'n' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "disqualified" ON "disqualified".molecule_id = "n".molecule_id WHERE "n".element = 'n' AND "disqualified".molecule_id IS NULL GROUP BY "n".molecule_id) AS "qualifying" LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) AS "count" FROM "atom" AS "chlorine" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "chlorine".atom_id = "c".atom_id WHERE "chlorine".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

WITH "triple_bond_molecules" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '#'), "label_counts" AS (SELECT "m".label, COUNT(*) AS "molecule_count" FROM "triple_bond_molecules" AS "t" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "t".molecule_id WHERE "m".label IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "m".label), "total" AS (SELECT SUM(molecule_count) AS "total_count" FROM "label_counts") SELECT CASE "lc".label WHEN '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' WHEN '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic' END AS "label", ROUND(100.0 * "lc".molecule_count / "total".total_count, 2) AS "percent" FROM "label_counts" AS "lc" CROSS JOIN "total" ORDER BY CASE "lc".label WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a".element IN (SELECT element FROM "atom" GROUP BY element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1) GROUP BY "a".molecule_id ORDER BY "a".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "atom_counts" AS (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_atoms", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'c') AS "carbon_atoms", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'cl') AS "chlorine_atoms" FROM "atom" GROUP BY molecule_id), "bond_ends" AS (SELECT "c".bond_id, "c".atom_id AS "atom_id" FROM "connected" AS "c" UNION ALL SELECT "c".bond_id, "c".atom_id2 AS "atom_id" FROM "connected" AS "c"), "carbon_bonds" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "e".bond_id FROM "bond_ends" AS "e" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".atom_id = "e".atom_id WHERE "a".element = 'c'), "bond_counts" AS (SELECT "b".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "number_of_bonds", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bonds", COUNT(DISTINCT "cb".bond_id) AS "carbon_touching_bonds" FROM "bond" AS "b" LEFT JOIN "carbon_bonds" AS "cb" ON "cb".bond_id = "b".bond_id GROUP BY "b".molecule_id) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "bc".carbon_touching_bonds DESC, "ac".number_of_atoms DESC, "m".molecule_id ASC) AS "rank", "m".molecule_id, "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label", "ac".number_of_atoms, "bc".number_of_bonds, "ac".carbon_atoms, "ac".chlorine_atoms, "bc".carbon_touching_bonds, "bc".multiple_bonds FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom_counts" AS "ac" ON "ac".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond_counts" AS "bc" ON "bc".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "ac".carbon_atoms > 0 ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "count" FROM "atom" AS "yt" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "h" ON "h".molecule_id = "yt".molecule_id AND "h".element = 'h' INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON ("c".atom_id = "h".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "h".atom_id) INNER JOIN "atom" AS "other" ON "other".atom_id = CASE WHEN "c".atom_id = "h".atom_id THEN "c".atom_id2 ELSE "c".atom_id END WHERE "yt".element = 'y' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(atom_bond_count), 2) FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, COUNT("c".bond_id) AS "atom_bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".atom_id) AS "atom_degrees" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a2".element AS "element", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a1".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') AND "a1".element = 'c' GROUP BY "a2".element ORDER BY "a2".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type AS "bond_kind", COUNT(*) AS "bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT (LEAST("a1".element, "a2".element), GREATEST("a1".element, "a2".element))) AS "element_pair_count", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR377' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "b".bond_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a".element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li') AND "b".bond_type = '-' ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT atom_id AS "atom_id" FROM "connected" INNER JOIN "bond" ON "bond".bond_id = "connected".bond_id WHERE "bond".bond_type = '-' UNION ALL SELECT atom_id2 AS "atom_id" FROM "connected" INNER JOIN "bond" ON "bond".bond_id = "connected".bond_id WHERE "bond".bond_type = '-') AS "single_atoms" ON "single_atoms".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".element <> 'na' AND "a".atom_id NOT IN (SELECT "multiple_atoms".atom_id FROM (SELECT atom_id AS "atom_id" FROM "connected" INNER JOIN "bond" ON "bond".bond_id = "connected".bond_id WHERE "bond".bond_type IN ('=', '#') UNION ALL SELECT atom_id2 AS "atom_id" FROM "connected" INNER JOIN "bond" ON "bond".bond_id = "connected".bond_id WHERE "bond".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_atoms") GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501
